name: app-oviah-colour-palette-tints-and-shades-with-hex-codes
title: OVIAH 'Visual Language of the app': five core colours each expanded into five tints and five shades
whatItIs: A slide with five large colour swatches (off-white #faf9f7, lilac #9890e7, navy #1f1e50, pale pink #f3dde1, coral pink #f192a3) each labelled with its hex code, and beneath each a small card showing five lighter tints and five darker shades with percentage labels.
whatItMeans: Scalable and precise; expanding each core colour into a full ramp equips every future UI state with the right shade.
techniques: Pair each core colour with its full tint and shade ramp.
Label tints and shades by percentage for exact reproduction.
Name the overall system 'visual language' to frame it as more than just colours.

vocabulary.definition: A colour mixed with white, making it lighter.
A colour mixed with black, making it darker.
